entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi there, thank you for calling VeloFit! My name is Steve. How can I help you today?
Hello, Steve. I need to return a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought a few weeks ago.
Okay, no problem at all. I can definitely help you with that. Can I get your name or order number to pull up your account?
Sure, the name is Anya Sharma.

Got it. One moment... Okay, Anya, I see your account right here. Looks like you're one of our VIP members, thank you for being such a loyal customer! And I see the VeloBand purchase. Let's see... yep, you're well within the 90 days, so we can get that returned for a full refund.
Oh, great. So it's not too late then?
Not at all. I'm generating a prepaid return label for you right now. I've just sent it to the email we have on file. Do you see it come through?
Let me check... yes, I just got it. That was fast.
Excellent. And as a thank you for being a VIP, I've also added a 15% discount code to that email for your next purchase with us. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Wow, thank you, Steve. That's very helpful. No, that's all I needed.
You're very welcome, Anya. Thanks again for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
